subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: are you brothers the mistress of the house said turning to the dervishes no by allah they said were poor woderers who met mere chance wwe pray for allahs pardon Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: "Are you brothers?" the mistress of the house said turning to the dervishes. "No, by Allah", they said, "We're poor wanderers who met by mere chance. We pray for Allah's pardon." Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 129
